cc:Work.dc:title: fig1 qpu paired mae by source
cc:Work.dc:description: Units: seconds. Row set: the three source rows for candidate=mali_graph_architecture_v3_large and reference=unified_polynomial_v3; shared n=340 Ma–Li, 4,481 Qonductor, 3,945 QPack. Each row's shared_row_set_hash is in the source CSV. Evaluation/output clock: archived_observed_service_execution_time. Limits: source slices are not source-specific training; Ma–Li interval crosses zero, Qonductor coverage is asymmetric, and this does not isolate graph structure. Sources: qpu/archived_method_pairwise_comparisons.csv SHA-256 46feff9632a48b7c852a938c0e5a153209d700e0574a5d8cd685c609ab5b1313
